notes.title: Development Diary | New Maps, Features and Improvements
notes.notes:
Hello, survivors! 

We would like to present to you our last two weeks' progress, and share with you our improvements and new features in the game.

• Now the enemies will attack the city more often. Every few days, the enemy will come to sweep the base and you need to defend against the attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/3741e0d08aeb13fdbb635034518f3e3fda8fb182.png[/img]

• Added function, where some civilians can join through the event. Some of them will come to the base at a specific time, which will help to expand the team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/47537e5db2a45ffd1ea8b5f4596116e6eb07b105.png[/img]

• Improved the function of rescuing prisoners, and the chance that they will join, after rescuing.

• Increased the chance of merchant visits. Villagers or wandering merchants near the base, may visit the base from time to time, see what they can purpose.

• Added a Battle Map - The Construction Site. The abandoned construction site, which contains a lot of building materials. But also, be careful, enemies may hide in the shadow...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/7559348fe377bb90ec77f7b5d17d8c69d84f5d96.png[/img]

• Added a Battle Map - The Military Base, stationed with the Uman Forces and huge amount of resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/ef10d6cc29df2c845bbb22bc134337b6cc6517f8.png[/img]

• Optimized the AI behavior of companions. Companions will consume items automatically when they are injured, hungry, tired, or bleeding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/50da37957ab517f24cb0b4f8c276f893133e7101.png[/img]

• Optimized UI performance and unified UI icon and buttons for each system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/abddaae2f5b84b728b8794dc6bfc11d4c5a9222c.png[/img]

• Added 2 new fortifications. Though these constructions might look a little weak, the protection is good. You need to use whatever you have to defend yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/505e18e8a353de19182229a1b24f8d88973ab2cc.png[/img]

We would like to know your opinion about the changes ;)
And [url=https://www.herwargame.com/subscribe]let's stay in touch[/url], so you don't miss any news!

notes.title: Development Diary: Gun accessories, NPC, event systems and more!
notes.notes:
[i][b]Hello survivors! [/b][/i]

For the last 2 weeks, our development team has been putting much more pieces together for Her War. We are absolutely thrilled to see our vision getting closer and closer to fruition. 
 
Development updates from the past 2 weeks:

[b]Added new dialogue system with NPCs [/b]
Players can learn about the NPCs’ background and personal preferences, which helps taking care of them better.

[b]Added new maps content of markets and logging camps [/b]
Players can scavenge food at the markets, but be careful, enemies will show up there as well. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/965238934bbde9ba6ede9269f6bd7b38c79457ec.png[/img]

[b]Improved NPCs’ buff status and characteristics[/b]  
Different personalities and habits will be morale factors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/ea5b078e47541b4ddac6bbf03edb746c080b0c26.png[/img]

[b]Added new scopes, flash hiders, suppressors and stocks for firearms[/b]
The accessories can effectively enhance combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/dc90c944cbf5f0d2e88bf2b2eb7587e0214dbb62.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/d070e4bae31249acd917c400a19a31b7f6e185e0.png[/img]

[b]Added window fixing in the base[/b]
Fixing the windows helps increase temperature in the base to reduce chance of illness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/faeda23cf40cec796affadb8ece229b0b717cf94.png[/img]

[b]Added camera rotation during base renovating [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/7b59444aed7a9c35fb7824fe422fc1a946d366d0.png[/img]

[b]Added event system[/b]
More dynamic gameplay will be introduced in the future.

[b]Added trading system[/b]
Trading with merchants for more powerful weapons, or medicines.

notes.title: Unite, Sisters of Cherniv, It’s Revenge Time!
notes.notes:
Hello! We are currently working very hard on developing “Her War,” an all-female FPS & survival strategy game. We would like to share some super exciting features of the game with you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/8656b37f77cedc4aacac1291831040e3508027aa.png[/img]

[b]Ultra-realistic team surviving system[/b]

After escaping from the horrific terrorist camp, our hero is destined to retake her homeland with the help of fellow female soldiers. As a true leader, you will need to take care of yourself and your troop when facing great threats of injuries, hunger, fatigue, illness. Keep the team warm and healthy is the key to survive and win the war. Dynamic time and weather settings will give you different challenges during different time of the year. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/11ed64f7073f480c1c69e2ca0b8f43007897fb71.png[/img]

[b]Sophisticated construction system for your base[/b]

Your legendary story begins in a dark and obsolete shelter. Find all the resource through scavenge and battle to upgrade the base into a warm home and a military fortress. Rich choices of materials for structure, fortification, furniture and decoration can be obtained through scavenge and battle. Build a workshop to produce weapons, ammo, medicines and even cigarettes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/be63d9fc99f655ef2f055ad941d501368827cdea.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/bcd8668c22fa94a35170e79c05754ab173fa924b.png[/img]

[b]Scavenge your resource, or fight enemies for it.[/b]

As your troop growing bigger and stronger, you will need more life-essential resource. There are no supermarkets in this hostile world. Defeat enemy force to take their supplies, or scavenge anything useful from the wild.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/50e082583fb54fd2b9994f58820727882d50c343.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/14a0a210feae9ae05f358052fe8e67ca5fad96c9.png[/img]

[b]Recruit, unite, fight.[/b]

Realizing you don’t have super power, you will search for other victims who suffer greatly from terrorist regime, and recruit them for your resistance troop. At the beginning, you need to keep them safe and healthy. Then, train them to fight and work for each other.


[b]Vivid battlefields and brutal shooting? Check. [/b]

Wage war on different terrains, and design your strategies accordingly. Make sure to avoid unnecessary enemy contact, and collect supplies during a battle. 
Each weapon has its unique recoil and trajectory. Damage is close to reality. One bullet can waste your enemy’s life. But they know they can use this against you too, if you are not cautious or well-armored. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/6cc7515f90fd2d6e71dc64391d1332162dada84d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/8bac5ae5ce51af0e07461828b1d19ce41db39664.png[/img]

[b]Stay sharp, defend your base.[/b]

The terrorists WILL raid your base ruthlessly. So fortify it with everything you have, as fast as you can. Protect the last lifeline of your people till the last breath. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36608605/08dd7c4421473d0d9c5156d171dab58edcf0ec6f.png[/img]




Stay tuned for more exciting news on the development of “Her War.” Follow us on social media, share, comment. Let us now how you feel about the update!
